mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wms_warehouse where status='0') warehouseCount, (select count(1) from wms_item where status='0') itemCount, (select coalesce(sum(quantity),0) from wms_stock) totalStock, (select coalesce(sum(quantity-locked_quantity),0) from wms_stock) availableStockQty, (select count(1) from (select i.item_id from wms_item i left join wms_stock s on s.item_id=i.item_id where i.status='0' and coalesce(i.min_stock,0)>0 group by i.item_id,i.min_stock having coalesce(sum(s.quantity-s.locked_quantity),0)<=i.min_stock) low) lowStockCount, (select coalesce(sum(total_qty),0) from wms_receipt where status='COMPLETED' and receipt_date>=curdate() and receipt_date<curdate()+interval 1 day) todayInbound, (select coalesce(sum(total_qty),0) from wms_shipment where status='COMPLETED' and shipment_date>=curdate() and shipment_date<curdate()+interval 1 day) todayOutbound, (select count(1) from wms_receipt where status='DRAFT') pendingReceipt, (select count(1) from wms_shipment where status='DRAFT') pendingShipment

select m.movement_id,m.biz_type,m.biz_no,m.warehouse_id,w.warehouse_code,w.warehouse_name,m.location_id,l.location_code,l.location_name, m.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,i.specification,i.unit,m.batch_no,m.change_qty,m.balance_qty,m.operator,m.operation_time,m.remark from wms_stock_movement m left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id=m.warehouse_id left join wms_location l on l.location_id=m.location_id left join wms_item i on i.item_id=m.item_id order by m.operation_time desc,m.movement_id desc limit 10
